_meta.description: Alternative audit standards selectable as the coverage denominator. Each framework's controls are assessed by projecting findings through the NIST 800-53 crosswalk (data/mappings/control_mappings.json): a finding's 800-53 anchor -> the framework's mapped sub-ids -> the framework 'control' via `project`. Catalogs are at each framework's natural control granularity and are publicly enumerable; cross-framework assessment completeness is bounded by crosswalk coverage (surfaced in the report's limitations).
_meta.granularity: framework-natural (CIS control, PCI requirement, CSF category, SOC 2 criteria group)
